description: Erection of rear and side roof extensions following the demolition of the existing hip to gable conversion.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 0473_98_EXPL201, 0473_98_204, 0473_00_001, 0473_00_010, 0473_00_ref101, 0473_00_ref002, 0473_00_ref003,  0473_00_104ab, 0473_00_R002, Planning, Design & Access Statement received 11 May 2023; Fire Safety Information received 23 May 2023; 0473_00_R003a, 0473_00_R006a, 0473_00_R101a, 0473_00_R104a, 0473_00_R105 received 22 June 2023..

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding any information given in the documents hereby approved, the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be as specified on the approved plans and include  plain roof tiles to match No 6 Oaklands Avenue white UPVC fenestration and the restoration of white painted timber windows in the front elevation.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Condition : 6 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
